_comment: Authoring config for the react-decor lib. The whole runtime is plain CommonJS with hand-written .d.cts twins as the type source for consumers — CJS is the one flavor every host loads natively: tsserver require()s the plugin, Vite/vitest config loaders externalize the bare 'react-decor/vite' specifier to a native Node import, ESLint flat config imports through Node's CJS interop, and the at-tsc bin runs buildless. ESLint's projectService picks this config up as the nearest tsconfig for lib files. test/__fixtures__ holds raw-@ sources that no standard parser can read — excluded here and ignored by eslint + prettier at the repo root.
